description: Compose a multi-party multi-asset send transaction. Sends multiple assets to multiple destinations in a single transaction. All three arrays must be the same length.

assets.description: Comma-separated asset names, one per recipient (e.g. "XCP,PEPECASH,XCP")

destinations.description: Comma-separated destination addresses, one per recipient

inputs_set.description: Comma-separated UTXOs to use as inputs (txid:vout)

quantities.description: Comma-separated raw integer quantities, one per recipient. For divisible assets: human amount * 10^8.

sat_per_vbyte.description: Fee rate in satoshis per virtual byte (e.g. 1, 5.5, 0.15). Check get_fee_estimate for current market rates.

name: compose_mpma
